tasks.short: Maintain actual attendance, grades and required student records.

steps.what: Capture actual student attendance and required record facts as events occur
Verify actual examiner-set grades and resolve missing or disputed student records
inputs: actual grades set by the appointed examiner

steps.what: Enter verified records in the LMS using the actual course roster
inputs: actual course roster maintained by student administration
outputs: complete LMS records and transfer preview

steps.what: Check the complete registry transfer preview against verified grades and student identities
inputs: complete LMS records and transfer preview
outputs: checked exact transfer version and registry destination

steps.what: Transfer the checked final grades to the distinct official student registry
inputs: checked exact transfer version and registry destination
outputs: official registry records and import reconciliation receipt

tasks.design: Use the LMS roster for initial record entry and a validated import to replace actual second-system grade re-entry in the official student registry. Actual attendance capture, examiner grade decisions, discrepancy work and the complete transfer check remain human; only the distinct official transfer is gated, not the author's ordinary LMS save.
tasks.previous_blocker: Actual LMS grades may be manually re-entered in a separate registry.
tasks.enabler_now: The documented Brightspace-to-OSIRIS record boundary supports a deterministic grade-transfer design.
tasks.still_hard: Actual attendance, identity mismatches and contested grades require people.
tasks.human_edge: Resolve why a student's official record differs from the underlying academic decision.
tasks.altitude: Check record consistency rather than retype approved academic results.

evidence.claim: The digest reports that Radboud Brightspace grades must also be published in OSIRIS, establishing a distinct record boundary, not measured savings.

assumptions: OTHER is the official student registry, such as OSIRIS. Shares30/20/15/10/25 are provisional, not measured. Apply s5 only where this teacher actually re-enters grades; an existing import receives no credit. Upstream examiner grading is existing work outside this records task, not a new free model input.

Initial attendance/fact capture remains s1, initial entry s3, full final-version identity/meaning check s4. Reconciliation of receipt discrepancies remains within retained checking; no model grades students. Machine transfer stops on missing identities, scale mismatch or edits after checking.
unknowns: What manual registry re-entry actually exists and which import fields are supported?
research_questions: Compare a real final transfer preview with official registry import requirements.

incremental.description: Maintain registry field mappings and investigate import exceptions beyond normal record checks.

approvals.approved_version: s4 exact final student identifiers, grades, scale and registry destination; edits void the check

time_saved_range_pct.basis: High removes25 actual second-system entry plus1.5 roster repetition less1.2 upkeep. Low: mixed historical grade scales require manual conversion and identity reconciliation, leaving only6 points of compatible record transfer plus0.5 stable roster entry removable, less1.2 upkeep. Capture30, grade verification20 and final check10 stay.

tasks.short: Advise students on academic, vocational and career choices.

steps.what: Understand the actual student's goals, circumstances and questions
Check current library-science curriculum and career references relevant to that student
inputs: current curriculum and careers references maintained by the institution
outputs: checked relevant study and career references

steps.what: Advise the student through actual discussion of suitable options and uncertainties
inputs: checked relevant study and career references
outputs: actual advice and next actions captured by teacher

steps.what: Write assigned factual advising notes in the internal student record
inputs: actual advice and next actions captured by teacher

tasks.design: Configure a native course-and-careers reference view to reduce repeated navigation to current institutional sources. Retain student understanding, individualized advice, actual decision capture and assigned written notes; no student recommendation is generated or sent by software.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated source navigation can consume time within student advice.
tasks.enabler_now: Current institutional reference links can be assembled in a native view.
tasks.still_hard: Appropriate advice depends on actual goals and constraints.
tasks.human_edge: Help a student explore uncertain ambitions without treating a course rule as a personal recommendation.
tasks.altitude: Bring current references into a human advising conversation.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native reference views reduce navigation while individualized student advice remains human.

assumptions: Shares35/15/40/10 are provisional, not measured. Only3 points of repeated navigation disappear from s2; source reading and applicability checking remain12. Current-source maintenance is existing institutional work; view upkeep is charged below.
s3 counts actual capture and s4 actual assigned note writing and ungated save. If no note is assigned, remove/reweight that work. No free transcript or new mandatory report is assumed.
unknowns: Which current career references can actually be linked?
research_questions: Observe repeated reference navigation separately from personal advice.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: High removes3 navigation points less0.5 upkeep. Low: a student considering an unfamiliar archival specialty needs new source research, leaving only0.9 points of familiar curriculum navigation removable, less0.5 upkeep. Actual student discussion75 and assigned note10 stay.

tasks.short: Select and obtain actual textbooks and teaching supplies.

steps.what: Select suitable textbooks and supplies against actual library-science teaching needs
Check supplier editions, availability and actual catalogue references for selected materials
Prepare the complete material order using checked supplier catalogue references
outputs: complete proposed order and supplier destination

steps.what: Authorize the complete final order against actual institutional budget and purchasing authority
inputs: complete proposed order and supplier destination

steps.what: Send the authorized exact order to the supplier
Obtain and inspect actual delivered textbooks and supplies
Record actual receipt and discrepancies in the internal purchase record

tasks.design: Use native procurement catalogue links and order templates for actual material orders. Keep educational selection, edition checks, the existing budget holder's final-order authorization, supplier send, physical receipt and fresh receipt entry; ordinary receipt saves receive no gate or saving.
tasks.previous_blocker: Supplier reference navigation and repeated order fields can recur after educational selection.
tasks.enabler_now: Native catalogue links and order defaults can reduce those specific repeated fields.
tasks.still_hard: Edition suitability, budget authority and delivered condition remain human.
tasks.human_edge: Recognize a pedagogically unsuitable edition despite matching catalogue metadata.
tasks.altitude: Spend less time preparing orders and retain educational selection.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native procurement catalogues and order defaults can reuse verified references without choosing teaching materials.

assumptions: Shares35/20/20/5/1/14/5 are provisional, not measured. Existing budget-holder review5 is other-role labour excluded from the teacher's95 denominator; it is not newly invented approval. Confirm this actual route before use.

s2 removes3 reference-navigation points; s3 removes2 stable-field points while retaining final order preparation. Receipt and its actual record occur after delivery. No assumed supplier API, free fresh metadata capture or automatic payment is proposed.
unknowns: Does procurement already populate selected catalogue items?
research_questions: Confirm actual purchasing authority and repeated order entry before estimating savings.

incremental.description: Maintain actual catalogue links and order defaults.

approvals.approved_version: s4 exact final item editions, quantities, prices and supplier destination; edits void authorization

Low: unusual imported titles need manual edition and availability checking, leaving1 navigation and1 stable order-field point removable:2/95 times100 less0.6, rounded down to1.5. Selection35, receipt14 and fresh receipt entry5 remain.

tasks.short: Supervise actual teaching, internships and research work.

steps.what: Review actual student work and current teaching, internship or research requirements
inputs: actual student work supplied by students

steps.what: Supervise actual teaching, internship and research activity and capture agreed feedback
outputs: actual feedback and follow-up captured by teacher

steps.what: Write assigned supervision notes using native course and placement record headings
inputs: actual feedback and follow-up captured by teacher

tasks.design: Use native supervision-note headings only for the teacher's actual assigned written record. Retain work review, live supervision, fresh feedback capture and all meaningful feedback writing; the ordinary internal save is retained and ungated.
tasks.previous_blocker: Stable course or placement headings can be typed again in supervision records.
tasks.enabler_now: Native document templates reuse those headings.
tasks.still_hard: Assessing student progress and giving useful supervision remain human.
tasks.human_edge: Notice an emerging problem that the submitted work alone does not explain.
tasks.altitude: Keep supervision records clear without replacing supervision.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: document templates reuse supervision-record headings without reviewing student work or giving supervision.

assumptions: Shares30/60/10 are provisional, not measured. s2 counts fresh feedback capture; s3 removes1 point of repeated headings only, retaining9 of actual notes/check/save. If no written record is assigned, remove and reweight s3 rather than invent a report.
No model grading, transcript, automated progress inference or new student-monitoring system is proposed.
unknowns: Are actual assigned supervision notes already templated?
research_questions: Observe stable record-heading repetition separately from actual feedback writing.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: High removes1 repeated heading point less0.3 upkeep. Low: an unusual internship requires a bespoke record and no reusable headings, retaining all writing and flooring net benefit at0. Work review30 and actual supervision60 remain fully retained.
